class.name: AgentTestRunner
class.description: Runs every [code]test_*[/code] method of the scripts extending [AgentTest] in a folder (default [code]res://tests/agent[/code]), one at a time, and prints failures with their traces and a summary. Options: [code]--filter <name>[/code], [code]--test-timeout <seconds>[/code], [code]--json[/code], [code]--json-out <file>[/code], [code]--junit-out <file>[/code], [code]--screenshot-dir <dir>[/code] and [code]--screenshot-scale <factor>[/code]. Exits with [code]1[/code] if a test failed. Not meant to be used directly.
